text: relate-phrases: when two link sources link the same pair, Reader._link gives the reason of the first source in module-name order (dictionary < latin < own_links). So a pair in --synonyms that RuWordNet also links shows '(synset)', not '(synonyms)'. SEMKIT-082 isolated tests/relate/test_own_links.py::test_an_item_of_several_words_is_matched_as_a_run with an empty test thesaurus. Decide if the caller's --synonyms reason must win; SEMKIT-085 can document the rule.
